import json

def get_board_hash(frame):
    """Get a hash of the board state based on segmentation"""
    seg = frame.segmentation
    nodes = []
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        nodes.append((n['color'], n['pixels'], n['hash'], tuple(n['boundary'])))
    return str(sorted(nodes))

# Get current board state
